d:
A neighbor drops by.
A man and a woman live together in a flat, often finding themselves arguing, at odds and under stress from work. But their volatile existence is interrupted when their downstairs neighbor, Steve, comes by, telling them there's water from their apartment leaking into his.
Steve finagles a cup of tea with the woman, chatting eccentrically but amiably enough. But that's not the end of the matter. Steve comes back and has another cup of tea, insinuating himself into their home in a series of increasingly unpredictable visits.
